corrections.old_text: plus less irritation, congestion and perceived oil production
corrections.new_text: plus less irritation and perceived oil production, while not causing forehead congestion
corrections.source_excerpt: It has not caused the congestion on my forehead that results in textured skin and bumps, while at the same time it nourishes my cheeks and keeps the reactivity threshold low.
corrections.reason: The diagnosis turns not causing congestion into reducing congestion. The source reports absence of that adverse effect, not improvement of pre-existing congestion.

summary: One material correction preserves the distinction between not causing congestion and reducing it.
